text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This method helps teams stay focused and track their progress. Breaking a project into milestones allows you to check advancement at key stages, while deliverables define exactly what must be completed and handed over. It is equally important to ensure stakeholder alignment, meaning everyone involved agrees on the objectives from the start. When goals, milestones, and deliverables are clearly communicated, the whole team works in the same direction and avoids misunderstandings.
